requestedTitle: Size discrepancies in the animated series
resolvedTitle: Size discrepancies in the animated series
wikitext:
{{missing image|article|Images for other Pokémon}} Aside from [[giant Pokémon]], many {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in the [[Pokémon animated series]] suffer from large '''size discrepancies''' between the information given in the [[Pokémon games]]' [[Pokédex]] and their actual animated presentation. These Pokémon are apparently "normal-sized" as far as the animated series universe is concerned. Many of {{cat|Ash's Pokémon}} are often subject to size discrepancies, often appearing smaller than other Pokémon of the same species. This may be a style or aesthetic decision, a depiction of juvenile Pokémon, a case of the writers not checking the information in detail, or for story purposes. Some of the most notable size discrepancies will be noted below.
